description: Header file defining the ProcCpuInfoReader class for parsing /proc/cpuinfo without using standard file I/O functions, including methods for reading fields and values.

classes.name: ProcCpuInfoReader
classes.description: A class for reading /proc/cpuinfo data without using fopen/fgets, providing methods to iterate over fields and extract their values.

methods.name: GetNextField
methods.description: Retrieves the next field name from /proc/cpuinfo, returning false at EOF or on error.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the last read field.

methods.name: GetValueAndLen
methods.description: Returns the value and its length of the last read field.
